prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1289; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather keep my name out of it for now, if that's alright. You already have my claim information.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was driving in the right lane on a main road in Pasadena, moving at around the speed limit. I wanted to move into the left lane because the lane ahead was closing, so I checked my mirror and signaled.

Q: Did you check your blind spot before moving over?

A: I did a head check as well as the mirror. The lane looked clear. Then a car came up alongside me and we scraped sides. It happened in a second.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not until it was right there. I didn't see it in the mirror when I looked.

Q: Did either of you stop, or did you pull over afterward?

A: Both cars pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged information and took a few photos of the damage.

Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the collision?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for a while or first get up in the morning. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and I saw a doctor who diagnosed a neck and back strain.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: I'm doing physical therapy twice a week and I'm following the exercises they gave me at home.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm trying to cooperate fully and I'll provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
